top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft Corp. today released software updates to plug at least 570 security holes in its Windows operating systems and other software, almost triple the number of vulnerabilities the software giant fixed in its record-smashing Patch Tuesday release last month. Microsoft attributed the burgeoning patch counts to vulnerability discoveries aided by artificial intelligence.

top_signals.title: Levi Strauss: Asia Key Growth Engine in $10B Rev. Goal
top_signals.summary: Levi Strauss President & CEO Michelle Gass says Asia is a key growth engine in the company's ambition to hit $10 billion in annual revenue. Gass adds that India and Japan are fueling the growth in the region. She speaks with Paul Allen on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Sports world steps up after deadly Kumamoto earthquake
top_signals.summary: Japan's sporting world has mobilized to support earthquake-hit Kumamoto, with leagues, clubs and players contributing to relief and encouraging donations for those affected.
